name: buddie
tagline: Checks AI agents' claims against primary evidence, with no model; observes only what you grant.
description:
buddie checks supported quotations, cited numbers and repository/GitHub claims against primary evidence, without a model in the check. It returns receipts naming failures and what could not be checked. Its environment tool observes only categories the person granted. It runs locally over MCP stdio; no buddie account or hosted endpoint is required.

Eight tools: verify_report, snap, source_text, summary, environment_snapshot, feedback_start, feedback_resolve and feedback_accept. verify_report and snap may fetch evidence and write local snapshots; feedback_start and feedback_resolve also write local feedback-chain state. feedback_accept reads the chain and checks that the final report is exactly its verified text. summary needs the Claude Code hook journal. PASS covers only supported checks that ran; GAPS and EMPTY are not passes.

Installing this MCP server does not gate Cline answers. The separate Claude Code/Codex plugins check supported claims at Stop, when an answer may already be visible, and request corrections. Session command checks need a Claude Code transcript.

env.name: BUDDIE_GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: Optional GitHub token for pr: and ci: anchors (private repositories, higher rate limit). Buddie never reads an ambient GITHUB_TOKEN.

install.notes: Requires uv and Python 3.11 or newer. The first start downloads the package; if Cline reports an initialize timeout on that first start, retry once (or run `uvx buddie@2.0.8 --version` beforehand). `snap` and `verify_report` fetch the URLs a report cites and write snapshots to ./.verbatim (or $VERBATIM_STORE). Privacy: https://github.com/tsyyan/buddie/blob/v2.0.8/PRIVACY.md
